s: Al mi mechallelin shabbat ubo y' seipim: kol piqquach nepesh docheh et hashshabbat, vehazzariz — hare zeh meshubbach. Apillu nopla deleqa bechatzer acheret veyare shemma taabor lechatzer zo veyabo lide sakkana, kegon sheyyesh bah choleh o qetannim veen shahut lehabricham terem shettaggia lah haddeleqa — mekabbin kede shello taabor. Vaapillu epshar lehabricham derek reshut harabbim gemura — mutab lekabbot, mippene shehakkibbuy melaka sheenah tzerika legupah hu, kemo shennitbaer besiman ra"ch, vehotzaat choleh o qetannim sheenam yekolim lelek hi melaka gemura, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"ch:

En holekin bepiqquach nepesh achar harob. En tzarik lomar im hayu tisha nokrim veyisrael echad omedim bechatzer, venopla mappolet al echad mehem beotah chatzer veen yadua im yisrael hu im nokri, shemmepaqqechin alayv et haggal, shehare hayyisrael vehannokri hayu qebuim beotah chatzer, vekol haqqabua hu kemechetza al mechetza, usepeq nepashot lehaqel. Ella apillu peresh echad mehem lechatzer acheret vesham nopla alayv mappolet, shehaya rauy lelek achar harob — ap al pi ken mepaqqechin alayv, shekkevan shennishar qebiut harishon bimqomo (bishat perishato mehaqqebiut) — hare anu choshebin oto keqabua immahem lehaqel bispeq nepashot. Abal im neeqru kullam bezeh achar zeh, ubishat aqiratam peresh echad mehem lechatzer acheret venopla alayv mappolet — en mepaqqechin alayv, shekkevan shennier kebar qebiut harishon mimmeqomo (bishat perishato shel zeh) — i epshar lehaqel bo mishshum qabua, veholekin bo achar harob shehem nokrim. Abal im neeqru kullam — hare adayin hem qebuim beyachad, ukeshepperesh echad mehem — hare peresh mehaqqabua, umepaqqechin alayv. Veken tinoq shennimtza beir sherubbah nokrim — yesh omerim sheen mechallelin alayv et hashshabbat, kevan shebbekol yom vayom poreshim kullam mimmeqom qebiutam — holekin achar harob (kemo shekkatub beeben haezer siman d', ayyen sham sheyyesh choleqin):

Mi shennopla alayv mappolet, sapeq odennu chay sapeq kebar met, sapeq hu sham sapeq eno sham, apillu im timtze lomar shehu sham sapeq yisrael sapeq nokri — mepaqqechin alayv, ap al pi sheyyesh bo kamma sepeqot, shehare omra tora "vachay bahem", shello yukal labo beshum inyan lide mitat yisrael al yede shemirat hammitzvot. Vaapillu metzauhu merutztzatz, sheeno yakol lichyot ella lepi shaa — mepaqqechim ubodeqim ad chotmo, im yesh bo chayyut — mepaqqechim umotziim oto bishbil chayye shaa, veim lo hirgishu bechotmo chayyut — az vadday kebar met, apillu eno merutztzatz. Ben sheppageu berosho techilla uben sheppageu beraglayv techilla, verau sheen chayyut belibbo — ap al pi ken bodeqin ad chotmo, ki iqqar hekker chayyut hu bechotem, shenneemar "kol asher nishmat ruach chayyim beappayv":
Matza elyonim metim — lo yomar "kebar metu hattachtonim", ella mepaqqeach alehem shemma hem chayyim. Maaseh haya umatzeu elyonim metim vetachtonim chayyim:
Habba bammachteret beinyan sheen lo dam umuttar leharego, venopla alayv mappolet sham — en mepaqqechin alayv (shehare en metzuvvin lehachayoto):

Nokrim shetztzeru al ayarot yisrael, im bau al isqe mamon — en mechallelin alehem et hashshabbat. Veim bau al isqe nepashot, vaapillu bau setam veyesh lachush shemma bau al isqe nepashot, vaapillu adayin lo bau ella memashmeshim labo — yotzeim alehem bikle zayin umechallelin alehem et hashshabbat. Ubeir hassemuka lassepar, apillu enan rotzim labo ella al isqe teben veqash — mechallelin alehem et hashshabbat, shemma yilkedu hair umishsham tehe haaretz nocha likkabesh lipnehem:

Yesh omerim shebbizman hazzeh sheanu darin ben haummot sheshsholelin vehoregin, apillu im lo bau ella al isqe mamon — mechallelin alehem et hashshabbat, lepi sheim lo yannichennu hayyisrael lishlol velaboz — yahargennu, vachazaqa sheen adam maamid atzmo al mamono, veyesh lachush shemma yaamod echad negdam veyehareg, vahare zeh eseq nepashot. Umikkol maqom, hakkol lepi hainyan. Abal yachid shebbau alayv liqqach mamono — yanniach lahem littol kol asher lo, velo yechallel shabbat apillu beissur dibre soperim, ella al derek shennitbaer besiman sh"a:

Haroeh sepina sheyyesh bah yisrael hamtorepet bayyam, veken nahar shotep, veken yachid hannirdap mippene nokri — mitzva al kol adam lechallel alehem shabbat kede lehatztzilam, vaapillu hu sapeq im yatztzil. Umikkol maqom, im yesh sakkana — en lo lesakken atzmo kede lehatztzil et chabero, meachar shehu chutz min hassakkana. Veap sheroeh bemitat chabero, veap al pi shehu sapeq vachabero vadday, mikkol maqom hare neemar "vachay bahem", velo sheyyabo lide sepeq mita al yede sheyyeqayyem mah shenneemar "lo taamod al dam reeka":
Kol hayyotzeim lehatztzil — chozerim bikle zenam limqomam im mitpachadim mippene hannokrim lishbot bamaqom shehitztzilu, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman t"z:
Mi sherotzim nokrim leonso lehamir, im mechallelin alayv lehatztzilo — nitbaer besop siman sh"v:
